items.title: 24.6.3 Peptides (amino acids ke jurne se bane compounds) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 24.6.3, with Quick Check 24.5 answered (PDF 131). Answers need review.

blocks.text: Amino acid molecules aapas mein bhi react kar sakte hain. Aik amino acid molecule ka acidic -COOH group doosre molecule ke basic -NH₂ group se react karta hai. Jab do amino acids aapas mein react karte hain to banne wale molecule ko dipeptide kehte hain.

blocks.alt: Do displayed amino acids, H2N-C(H)(R)-C(=O)-OH aur H-N(H)-C(H)(R)-COOH, jin ka OH aur H shaded (rangeen) aur 'atoms lost to form water' likha, neeche H2O + ki taraf arrow; neeche dipeptide H2N-C(H)(R)-C(=O)-N(H)-C(H)(R)-COOH jis ka C=O aur N-H shaded aur 'Peptide link' likha, aur 'a dipeptide'.
blocks.caption: Dipeptide ka banna aur peptide link (kitab ke page 131 par chhape diagram ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Pehle amino acid ke -COOH ka OH aur doosre ke -NH₂ ka aik H mil kar paani (H₂O) bante hain. Bache hue C=O aur N–H jur kar peptide link (-CO-NH-) banate hain.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ne pehle amino acid ke carbonyl carbon par ‘H’ aur double bond chhapa hai (C=H), jo ghalat hai; wahan oxygen (C=O) hota hai, jaisa neeche dipeptide mein bhi hai.

Shaded (rang kiya hua) hissa do amino acids ke beech amide bond hai. Do amino acid molecules ke beech amide bond ko peptide bond ya peptide link bhi kehte hain. Yeh condensation reaction hai, kyunke molecules ke jurne par aik chhota molecule, yahan paani, nikal jata hai.

blocks.title: Isoelectric point
blocks.text: Woh pH jis par kisi amino acid par us ke paani wale solution mein koi kul (overall) charge na ho.

blocks.title: Tripeptide
blocks.text: Teen amino acids ke condensation reaction se banne wala compound.

blocks.title: Polypeptide
blocks.text: Bohat se amino acids ke condensation se banne wala compound.

blocks.prompt: Aspartic acid aur lysine ke R groups (-CH₂–COOH) aur (-CH₂-(CH₂)₃NH₂) hain. (a) In ke displayed formulae, (b) zwitterions, (c) acidic conditions mein ions aur (d) basic conditions mein ions banayein, aur batayein ke in ke isoelectric point ka kya matlab hai.
blocks.explanation:
(a) Aspartic acid: HOOC–CH₂–CH(NH₂)–COOH; lysine: H₂N–(CH₂)₄–CH(NH₂)–COOH.
(b) Zwitterions: HOOC–CH₂–CH(NH₃⁺)–COO⁻; H₂N–(CH₂)₄–CH(NH₃⁺)–COO⁻.
(c) Acidic conditions: HOOC–CH₂–CH(NH₃⁺)–COOH; H₃N⁺–(CH₂)₄–CH(NH₃⁺)–COOH.
(d) Basic conditions: ⁻OOC–CH₂–CH(NH₂)–COO⁻; H₂N–(CH₂)₄–CH(NH₂)–COO⁻.
Isoelectric point woh pH hai jis par molecule par kul (overall) charge zero ho. Aspartic acid mein aik extra acidic group hai, is liye us ka pI kam (taqreeban 3) hai; lysine mein aik extra basic group hai, is liye us ka pI zyada (9.74) hai.

items: Dipeptide (2 amino acids), tripeptide (3), polypeptide (bohat se).
